tailored:
Dear Koppla Team,

I'm applying for the Product Engineer - Frontend role. I'm a fullstack developer with hands-on experience building complete products in TypeScript-based stacks, and I'm genuinely excited about growing into full stack ownership at a product-driven startup.

My project TalentHiv is a fullstack AI-driven candidate screening system where I built the frontend with Next.js, React and TypeScript, designed REST APIs with clear separation of routes, services and schemas, and handled validation, error management, testing and type checking end-to-end. I also shipped it to production-like cloud infrastructure (Azure App Service, Vercel), so I'm comfortable with the full feature-building process, not just the code.

On the backend side, I've worked with PostgreSQL, data modelling and Python/FastAPI services, and my current project SoloAdventurer includes real-time WebSocket features — experience that maps directly to your websockets and API work. I care about clean code, code reviews and pragmatic trade-offs, and I want to keep learning from senior engineers while taking real ownership.

Before switching to software, I spent 20 years leading operational teams in a regulated, security-critical environment, which shaped my sense of ownership, structure and collaboration. I'd love to bring that mindset plus my engineering skills to koppla's Berlin team, and I'm ready to relocate.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
